ListFilesAsync(string?, CancellationToken)

Lists the files whose path starts with a prefix, without downloading them.

IAsyncEnumerable<FileDescriptor> ListFilesAsync(string? prefix = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

Parameters

prefix string

The beginning of the paths to list, such as invoices/2026/. A repository has no real folders: a folder is the prefix its files share. null or empty lists every file.

A token to cancel the asynchronous operation.

Returns

IAsyncEnumerable<FileDescriptor>

MoveFileAsync(string, string, CancellationToken)

Moves a file to another path in the same repository, which is also how a file is renamed.

Task<IFile> MoveFileAsync(string sourcePath, string targetPath, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

Parameters

sourcePath string

The path of the file to move.

targetPath string

The new path of the file. What is there is replaced.

cancellationToken CancellationToken

A token to cancel the asynchronous operation.

Returns

Task<IFile>

A task representing the asynchronous operation, containing the metadata of the file at its new path.

Remarks

The file is copied and then the original is removed. If the removal fails the file exists at both paths; it is never lost.

Exceptions

FileNotFoundException

Thrown when sourcePath does not exist.

ArgumentException

Thrown when both paths are the same.

MoveFilesAsync(string, string, CancellationToken)

Moves every file whose path starts with a prefix to another prefix, keeping the rest of each path — which is how a folder is renamed.

Task<int> MoveFilesAsync(string sourcePrefix, string targetPrefix, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

Parameters

sourcePrefix string

The beginning of the paths to move, such as drafts/.

targetPrefix string

What replaces sourcePrefix in each path, such as final/.

cancellationToken CancellationToken

A token to cancel the asynchronous operation.

Returns

Task<int>

A task representing the asynchronous operation, containing the number of files moved.

Remarks

Files are moved one at a time. If it stops midway, the files already moved stay at the target and the others at the source; running it again finishes the move.

Exceptions

ArgumentException

Thrown when a prefix is empty or both are the same.
